podcast.body: Featured on the "X and Y" album (2005), this song knowingly interpolates Kraftwerk's "Computer Love" (1981). Coldplay obtained permission, leading to Kraftwerk sharing in songwriting credits and earning millions in royalties. "It features the song Talk and it interpolates computer love."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

podcast.body: The melody line for this song, from the *X&Y* album, was intentionally borrowed from Kraftwerk's "Computer Love." Kraftwerk was cool with Coldplay's use of their melody. "And yes, Coldplay does know they left the melody line for Talk from the X and Y album."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
